messages:
sara: FYI customer reported a redeemed promo but no credits hit their balance. UI shows success and they received email. Org: org_4721. Redeem time: 2026-03-15T14:18:07Z.
acme-cse: Confirmed from customer: they clicked 'Redeem' via SSO, got green check and email. They tried generating embeddings and saw no credit usage decrease.
raj: Can you paste the webhook delivery ID or any log lines? also which promo code?
sara: Promo code = SPRINGLAUNCH2026. From webhook logs we got a 200 from billing service: delivery_id=wh_8902. Here's the callback payload we recorded:
```
{
  "delivery_id": "wh_8902",
  "org_id": "org_4721",
  "code": "SPRINGLAUNCH2026",
  "amount": 1000,
  "status": "accepted"
}
```
kyle: Quick checks: 1) Did ledger write succeed? 2) Was the grant mapped to a billing account vs org? 3) Any DB constraint errors around apply_grant?
sara: I just queried the ledger: ran `SELECT * FROM grants WHERE org_id='org_4721' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 5;` — returns nothing for that time window.
raj: OK that suggests webhook accepted but ledger ingest failed. Can you check our ingest service logs around 14:18? ops-bot might have trace.
ops-bot: trace created: trace_id=trace-5531 for webhook wh_8902, status=ingest_attempted, downstream_response=422.
raj: 422 from ledger service — need the ledger service error. sara can you get the raw ledger error (stack or message) from ingest logs?
sara: Pasted error snippet from ingest logs: 
```
2026-03-15T14:18:08Z ERROR applyGrant org=org_4721 code=SPRINGLAUNCH2026 err="foreign key violation: billing_account_id null"
```
raj: Ah — grant applied requires billing_account_id mapping. Looks like org_4721 doesn't have a linked billing account in our grants path (new SSO orgs sometimes miss mapping).
acme-cse: Customer's billing account exists, we confirmed. Might be an env mismatch: they redeem via SSO on private deployment? customer is on Dedicated.
kyle: Good catch. Two follow-ups: 1) workaround to credit manually via admin tool and 2) fix ingest to fallback to org->billing lookup when billing_account_id null.
raj: For immediate remediation: sara please 1) run the admin grant apply flow: `POST /internal/admin/grants/apply` with body:
```
{ "org_id": "org_4721", "amount": 1000, "reason": "manual remediation SPRINGLAUNCH2026", "source": "support-escalation" }
```
I will add an audit tag. After that confirm the customer's balance and notify them.
sara: On it. Will run and follow up with the customer.
acme-cse: Customer appreciated the quick response. They can wait for the manual credit, want confirmation when done.
raj: I'll open a GH issue for the ingest fallback and include the ingest log snippet + ops trace. Assign to eng-infra, priority P2.
kyle: Also adding a monitoring alert: track 422s from ingest by code and org mapping, so we catch this class of errors.
sara: Manual grant posted, audit_id=audit_9988. Customer balance now shows +1000 credits. I notified them. Closing the thread after engineering ticket is created.
raj: Thanks. Please attach the support transcript and the audit ID to the GH issue. :thumbsup:
